notes:
A big release: guided setup with the new Palette scaffold agent, zero-install agent CLIs, a proper diff viewer, and reviewable folder updates.

### New

- **Guided setup agent** — a built-in Palette agent walks you through getting set up, so a first run doesn't start from a blank page.
- **Reviewable folder updates** — when a session wants to update a folder, you can look over the change before it lands.
- **Side-by-side diffs** — file changes now render as a clean, GitHub-style unified diff instead of raw text.
- **Built-in Palette docs** — agents can look up Palette's own documentation without any setup on your part.
- **Shared HTML in Organisational context** — HTML files shared with you now show up alongside the rest of your organisational context.
- **A friendlier installer** — the drag-to-Applications window now has a proper background image.

### Improved

- **Automatic agent install** — turning an agent on installs everything it needs; no terminal, no manual steps.
- **Runtimes stay current** — Palette checks its managed tooling for updates when you launch it or switch back to it, and only uses agent CLIs already on your machine when they're new enough to work properly.
- **Simpler agent quickstart** — the agent step during quickstart is now a straightforward switch.
- **Tidier composer toolbar** — the controls under the message box now line up at a single, consistent height.

### Fixed

- **Allow All and Plan on Gemini and Mistral** — both modes now behave the same way they do on other agents, and Allow All stays inside your workspace instead of reaching beyond it.
- **Crossed-over conversations** — replies can no longer land in the wrong tab when several sessions are running at once, and Gemini and Mistral messages now attach to the turn that produced them.
- **Session picker hangs** — if one provider fails to list its sessions, the picker now finishes loading instead of spinning.
- **Handing off a session** — the new session is now seeded reliably once its composer is ready.
- **Publishing to read-only Drive folders** — Palette now tells you upfront instead of failing partway through.
- **Merging reviewed changes** — the exact revision you reviewed is what gets merged.
- **Codex model list** — the cached model list is checked against the Codex CLI actually in use, so you don't see models that aren't available.
- **Permission prompts** — tool permission requests are matched to the right request more reliably.
- **Slack community link** — the invite in Help works again.
